reason: This is the only experiment on the immutable board. It changes only the output store order, so its correctness risk is lower than a descriptor or layout change; each ZA tile must still map to its existing destination. Store locality benefit is unverified. Prior AC Automatic evidence shows the tested transpose and traversal changes did not beat their paired controls consistently, so it does not support a speedup claim for this proposal. Validate it with the required ten reports and paired controls.
